//: The server half. Separate from tsconfig.json because api/ runs in Node with no DOM, and runs as real Node ESM: Vercel compiles each file without rewriting import specifiers, so a relative import missing its .js extension resolves in every bundler and dies only when deployed. NodeNext resolution makes tsc enforce the deployed runtime's rules, turning that crash into a typecheck error. vite.config.ts is included because it imports the same handlers to serve them in dev.
